summary: Event-heavy day, not a quiet tape: the Fed decision lands today with Microsoft and Alphabet reporting after the close, and a long list of names print within 5 trading days (CVS and CALX today; AAPL, LNG, BDC, BJRI, HWM tomorrow; CLX and IDXX on 11-02). Company-specific news is thin. The main items are Dropbox's 9% layoff with an 8-K 5.02 that is unread, DoorDash's reported $17B Instacart deal (still unconfirmed), and Garmin's beat-and-raise. I count trading days myself: the file's days_to_earnings is calendar days, so 11-02 is 3 trading days out, not 5. Per L2, I resolved stale earnings estimates from filings (RRC, DORM, EXLS, LOGI, GRMN, MSCI), and INCY is still unverified.

Bitcoin is back around $80k after a rebound on 10-27 (ETF inflow $110M, crypto rose with stocks), but the contested-support story is intact: bears cite $72k-$76k, and a post-midterm dip to $63k-$75k is discussed. notable.headline: Dropbox to cut about 9% of headcount (cash cost $27M-$33M); expects Q3 in line or above guidance; 8-K items 2.02, 2.05, 5.02 filed today
notable.read: Restructuring with a preannounced in-line-or-better quarter, which lowers print risk, but the 8-K 5.02 officer change is unread, so the departure is unknown. Treat as unverified management-change risk until the filing is read.

notable.headline: DoorDash in advanced talks to acquire Instacart for about $17B (WSJ/The Information 10-26/27)
notable.read: Continues the 10-23 'exploring a sale' report and the 10-27 flag. Nothing new today and no company confirmation or 8-K 1.01, so the story is stalled at reports. It is a deal-gap situation in both directions, not an earnings one.

notable.headline: Garmin Q3 adj EPS $2.76 vs $2.40, sales $1.986B vs $1.989B; raises FY26 EPS guide to $10.80 and sales to $8.15B
notable.read: A real beat and a raise well above the $10.13 consensus; the sales line was flat to estimates. The 10-28 earnings flag resolves with a favorable print, and any reaction will show at the open.

notable.headline: Range Resources Q3 adj EPS $0.81 beats $0.77, sales $836.6M beats $798.6M; 8-K 2.02 filed 10-28; Mizuho PT $67
notable.read: Resolves the open earnings-date question from L2 (the 10-14 8-K is now moot). The beat is secondary to the EQT all-stock deal, which sets the price; a pending-merger position carries EQT exposure.

notable.headline: Logitech Q2 adj EPS $1.51 vs $1.26; Q3 sales guide $1.36B-$1.43B vs $1.314B est, but net sales -5% to 0% constant currency including a $70M-$80M supplier-incident hit
notable.read: Beat with a Q3 dollar-sales guide above consensus, but the supplier incident is a real one-quarter drag expected to be mostly resolved by Q4. The stock is listed among premarket decliners, so the market is reading the constant-currency decline.

notable.headline: ExlService Q3 adj EPS $0.62 beats $0.56, sales $634M beats $615M; raises FY26 EPS to $2.34-$2.36 (est $2.29) and sales to $2.43B-$2.44B
notable.read: Clean beat and raise; the earnings flag from 10-26/27 is resolved. Reaction is the open question.

notable.headline: UBS cuts IDEXX PT to $627 from $670, Neutral
notable.read: A second target cut in eight days (after Jefferies to $705 on 10-20) ahead of the roughly 11-02 print, which is 3 trading days out. IDXX was bought on 10-20, so this is a negative drift to watch, though both firms keep their ratings.

notable.headline: WSJ: New Labor Department regulation will force pharmacy-benefit managers to disclose how they are paid
notable.read: A regulatory headwind for Caremark's spread economics, arriving on the estimated earnings date. It adds to the earlier Medicare Advantage and insulin-suit background.

notable.headline: Korea fines Apple KRW 20.81B over app-store payment rules; iPhone Duo replacement program; touchscreen MacBook Pro event today
notable.read: The fine is immaterial, and the Duo defect was already flagged 10-27. Today's catalyst is the product event followed by an earnings print on 10-29 or 11-02, which is the key uncertainty. AAPL-tagged Bezos, O'Leary, CNBC Final Trades and Kobeissi pieces are commentary.

notable.headline: Datavault AI plunges nearly 40% after invalidating financial statements tied to a $150M Bitcoin deal
notable.read: A credibility hit for a small-cap crypto-treasury name, not an exchange or regulatory event. It is worth noting only because it pairs with Strategy pausing purchases as signs of strain among treasury buyers.

notable.headline: Analysts preview Tapestry's Q1 FY27 report on November 5 (EPS estimate $1.55)
notable.read: Confirms the date at 6 trading days, just outside the window. The negative PT drift (UBS, Jefferies, Baird) is unchanged and no fourth cut appeared today.

notable.headline: Fed decision today; Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close; Burry says the market mirrors the eve of the dot-com crash
notable.read: The AI-bubble thread (from 10-20 through 10-27) continues with no new hard fact; the two events that matter are the Fed and the mega-cap capex commentary tonight.
